en:
What a colossal death flag. I'll be 
surprised if he *doesn't* die after that.

More importantly...let's continue the
conversation where we left off.

We understand Miu plotted the murder,
but we need to find out <CLT=cltSTRONG>who killed her<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

And in order to figure that out, we need to
understand Miu's actions...

So, let's discuss her murder scheme
step-by-step!

I know that's important, but hearing you 
lead the conversation really pisses me off.

Let's see, Miu manipulated the Virtual World
to use it as part of her murder plan...
Don't just ignore me and start anyway...

If she had succeeded, she would've gone past
the wall between the chapel and mansion...

and then—WHAM!—murdered me on the
roof with the hammer.

She would make the murder seem like it happened
in the real world, and then pin it on Kaito.

As for Miu's alibi in the real world, she could
say she was logged into the Virtual World...

And in the Virtual World, she could say
she was near the chapel the entire time.

She'd make an excuse about how she couldn't
reach the mansion cuz of the fallen bridge.

Problem is, because of her murder plans,
we don't even know where she was killed.
She was killed on the <CLT=cltSTRONG>roof<CLT=cltNORMAL>, right?

Kokichi told us the roof door was locked,
and that he couldn't get through.
Maybe...that when culprit kill her?

That's probably what happened.
The culprit killed her on the locked roof.
Did the culprit lock the door to the roof?
Perhaps. I don't think Miu did it.

If Miu did lock it, she would have done it
when she called Kokichi to the roof.

Even if someone came up, I don't believe
she would change the target of her plan.

She knew that Kokichi would come up later.
Locking the door would be suspicious.

Well, it's possible she didn't 
even think that far ahead...

She was smart... 
But she was also really, really dumb.
N-No say such mean things.
Killing game bad, not Miu.

Miu not bad person. Gonta think we
coulda been friends, if things different.

That...might've been difficult.
Even without this killing game.
That wouldn't happen.
Nuh-uh. No way, Jose.
Huh?

Anyway...let's continue the discussion.
If Miu was killed on the roof of the mansion...

The culprit must have moved Miu's avatar
to the chapel after killing her, right?

So the next thing we should talk about
is how they moved her avatar.

Now we know that the mansion and 
chapel were actually next to each other.
But the problem is the wall between them.

Only Miu was able to go through that wall.
The culprit wouldn't have been able to...

Then you're saying the culprit sent
Miu's avatar through that wall?
Yeah, that's the only way, right?

But how did the culprit send Miu's
avatar through the wall?
I mean, it's not like they coulda thrown her.
Gonta not throw her!

We know. You couldn't because the avatars'
<CLT=cltSTRONG>physical strength was equalized<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Physical strength...equalized?

That problem! Gonta no can protect
everyone if that happens!

Geez, keep up with us. We're already 
in the second half of the class trial.

Hmmm... How did they send Miu's avatar
to the other side of the wall?

Maybe that thing has something to do with it?
Y'know...the <CLT=cltSTRONG>loud sound<CLT=cltNORMAL> you heard?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>BANG!!!
Ah!?
Wh-What!? What was that sound!?

Because of that sound, you guys went to
the side of the chapel. Right, Kee-boy?

That's when you found the dead Miu there,
riiiiight?

If so, then I think that sound and her avatar
being by the chapel are related...

<CLT=cltMIND>Yes, there's no doubt in my mind
that the noise is related to this case.

<CLT=cltMIND>We need to figure out what
that sound could have been...

<CLT=cltMIND>It might be the clue we need
to solve this case.

<CLT=cltMIND>So what was it? It sounded like something
slamming hard into something else...

<CLT=cltMIND>So what were those two things?
It could be...
The hammer hitting the wall

The sound we heard was the hammer
hitting against the wall.

Would a hammer make that much noise?
It sounded like something bigger...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
The cell phone hitting the wall

Perhaps Miu threw her
cell phone against the wall?

Hmm... I don't think it would make
such a loud noise, though.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
The lattice hitting the wall

Maybe the lattice work next to Miu's
avatar struck the wall...

Do you think a lattice would make such
a loud noise?

I don't think the impact would be loud enough
to startle everyone into going outside...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Miu hitting the wall
I wonder what that sound really was...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>That sound we heard, like
two objects colliding...

I think the sound came from
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Miu's avatar<CLT=cltNORMAL> hitting the chapel wall...

The hammer, cell phone, and lattice were there,
but they were too small to make that noise.

Ruling those out, the only other explanation is
that the sound was Miu colliding with the wall.

If that's the case, Miu's avatar must
have hit the chapel wall really hard.

We felt the impact all the way from
the inside of the chapel.
Yeah, that's the real question.

Miu's avatar probably hit the chapel's wall
with pretty considerable force...

But why did it hit the wall with such
force? Can you guys figure it out?

Hold on, Kokichi. What's up with the way
you're talkin'?
Why are you talking like you know everything!?
...Let's not worry about that right now.

More importantly, we gotta solve the mystery!
Fighting among friends is a waste of time.
"Friends"? Us?

Anyway...can we talk about that after
we figure this problem out?

A way of transporting Miu's avatar that would
cause it to crash into the chapel...

<CLT=cltMIND>Getting Miu's avatar to crash into
the chapel from the mansion's roof...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's only one way I can think
of how to do that.

Hey, Shuichi... As your partner, I'll give you
a little hint.
...You'll what?

Since the mansion was on top of a hill, the
roof was pretty high up, right?

Past the brick handrail, the roof
was at a pretty steep slope...

And the slope faced the chapel wall.
On top of that, there was snow on the roof.

If the culprit needed force to move the
body, I wonder how they did it?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi is talking as if he's got
the whole thing figured out already...

<CLT=cltMIND>But I can't let him distract me.
I need to solve the case.

<CLT=cltMIND>How to make Miu hit the chapel wall
from the roof of the mansion...
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm going to find the answer!
